risk_note: RV2 (payout account verification). A worker-only IdentityWorkerModule and a 60 s loop (started after risk-scan-heal, stopped first on shutdown, runs never overlap) take reserved / unknown payout_account_verify_attempts oldest first (reserved_at, id; 100 per run) and apply B1-13f's takeover (reserved past the in-flight lease → unknown) and recheck (query by the original vendor_request_id, never resend; matched / mismatched / expired_unresolved; past the recheck deadline → expired_unresolved with one pino error line holding user_id, verify_date and vendor_request_id only) through per-row conditional updates (status and row_version as read), so concurrent runners and in-request rechecks change a row once. Only verification attempts change: no payout account writes, no quota refunds. Unwired vendors (staging / prod) expire at the deadline. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
